findings.title: Exemplary PEP Screening Procedures

source.text: All 4 best practice checks completed: (1) Employer Background Verification, (2) Role Analysis, (3) Senior Management PEP Screen, (4) Adverse Media Search.

reference.text: Best Practice: For clients working in financial services or in jurisdictions with elevated risk, additional checks are encouraged: employer background verification, role analysis, senior management PEP screening, and adverse media searches.

findings.deviation: File demonstrates all four recommended best practice checks for a client in financial services based in an elevated risk jurisdiction. Exceeds minimum screening requirements.
